name: chart
title: Inline chart panel
description: Spawn or dismiss an inline chart panel via show_chart / hide_chart tools. Ships a fat SKILL.md teaching when to visualize vs. answer in prose, plus a placeholder React component the agent can swap with any chart library.

resolverRow.trigger: show me stats, visualize, give me a graph

nextSteps: 1. The SKILL.md was written to .pilot/skills/chart/SKILL.md and a row was appended to .pilot/RESOLVER.md.
2. Mount the plugin under <PilotPlugins> so the actions register:
3. Render <ChartPanel> wherever an inline panel makes sense in your layout.
4. The placeholder body is intentionally bare. Swap in your charting library (Recharts, visx, ECharts, ...) — keep the prop interface stable so the agent's mental model survives the swap.
5. Edit .pilot/skills/chart/SKILL.md to tune the trigger phrases and anti-patterns for YOUR app's data.
